mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM question WHERE id = #{questionId} AND status = 'ENABLED'

INSERT INTO favorite (profile_id, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{entity.profileId}, #{entity.targetType}, #{entity.targetId}) ON CONFLICT (profile_id, target_type, target_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, profile_id AS "profileId", target_type AS "targetType", target_id AS "targetId", created_at AS "createdAt"

SELECT f.id AS "favoriteId", q.id AS "questionId", q.title, q.star_level AS "starLevel", f.created_at AS "createdAt" FROM favorite f JOIN question q ON q.id = f.target_id WHERE f.profile_id = #{profileId} AND f.target_type = 'QUESTION' AND q.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
